262502|3e8465bb.name: Brix Xizzix
262502|3e8465bb.text: When I heard that there was a whole new gaggle of elves literally fallin' from the sky, I said to myself "THAT'S where I need to be". A whole new society of impressionable, bright-eyed suckers... er--customers!

4488|642d4f58.name: Parqual Fintallas
4488|642d4f58.text: It's always nice when someone wishes to speak to me. How are things with you, $c?

1102-accept.name: Steel
1102-accept.text:
Cairne is a noble leader for uniting our people here on Thunder Bluff.

But I cannot forgive those who drove us from our ancestral lands as easily as some. My people inhabited the southern Barrens for decades. The land was holy to us. But we were driven off by numerous foes.

A vengeful fate awaits the crone, Charlga Razorflank, who musters a foul army from within Razorfen Kraul.

Bring me Razorflank's heart and I can die in peace, $N.
1102-accept.title: A Vengeful Fate

1159-complete.name: Parqual Fintallas
1159-complete.text:
Braug sent you? Impossible.

<Parqual looks you up and down.>

Braved Dor'Danil, took a leap of faith, fought and overpowered a powerful elemental? Bah! You're probably a farce; some adventurer that overheard talk in a tavern. And now you think you have what it takes to pass my test. So be it... $c.
1159-complete.title: Test of Lore

1160-accept.name: Parqual Fintallas
1160-accept.text:
I will tell you what you must seek, and I will even ask you my question, but not because you wish to prove yourself. Knowledge is far more important than strength. Even as others seem to pass you by in ability, your knowledge of the world will be more valuable.

Go to the Monastery in the north of Tirisfal Glades. In the library there, a book called Beginnings of the $R Threat resides. It was used by the now-corrupt paladins there to train them to fight my kind.

Bring it to me.
1160-accept.title: Test of Lore

96241-accept.name: Mazu'kon
96241-accept.text:
Something funny be happenin' over there at Gloomrise. Ol' Mazu'kon be hearin all about these nasty new beasties skitterin' all around there.

Some say those creepy crawlies got a venom that have some unique properties and this be gettin' me curious. Take my extractor. Use it on the dead bodies layin' around that place to harvest the venom. Do this and I be in ya debt, mon.
96241-accept.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96241-complete.name: Mazu'kon
96241-complete.text:
Heh... when I said unique properties, I wasn't kiddin' mon! You seem no worse for wear, so it be all good.

Thank you for your aid, $c. It be much appreciated.
96241-complete.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96241-progress.name: Mazu'kon
96241-progress.text: Did ya get what I need?
96241-progress.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96259-accept.name: Steel
96259-accept.text:
There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.

It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.
96259-accept.title: Defending the Dead

96259-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
96259-complete.text: Thank you for your service to the people of this land. It may take time for us to completely clear out the infestation, but your efforts have created a stable foothold for us to leverage against these vile creatures.
96259-complete.title: Defending the Dead

96260-complete.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-complete.text:
These are excellent samples, and more than sufficient for my needs.

Here, take this. I was able to craft a rather unique cloak with a weave I spun from the small sample of silk already in my possession. I am hopeful that you will find it useful in your travels.

Earthmother watch over you, $c.
96260-complete.title: Stronger than Steel

96260-progress.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-progress.text: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260-progress.title: Stronger than Steel

96261-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
96261-complete.text:
Reanimated dead? The broodmother possessing a night elven form? These are troubling revelations. One has to wonder what it all means... I fear that must be a concern for a later time.

Thank you, $N. You've done the Earthen Ring and the people of Mulgore a great service.
96261-complete.title: The Broodmother

96294-accept.name: Unknown
96294-accept.text:
<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise.

You notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>
96294-accept.title: A Darker Truth

96294-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
96294-complete.text:
This is... most disturbing. Why would a druid be behind a brood of dangerous spiders? Who or what is this "Wild King" and "Pact" that is referenced in this letter?

I will confer with the druids of the Cenarion Circle on this. Perhaps they will know more.

Thank you again for your aid. As disturbing as this information is, we will rest easier knowing that the person controlling these vile creatures has been destroyed.
96294-complete.title: A Darker Truth

96988-accept.name: Doctor Martin Felben
96988-accept.text:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988-accept.title: Source of Power

97985-complete.name: Calder Gray
97985-complete.text:
Excellent! I can hardly contain my excitement. Oh, and the heart still has electrical pulses? That's impressive. I won't have to shock it back to life then!

This heart will be a wonderful addition to the abomination, and certainly looks to be the specified size, if these notes are correct.

Ah, I love it when a plan comes together.
97985-complete.title: Thundering Hearts

97985-progress.name: Calder Gray
97985-progress.text: Oh, you've returned in one piece! Pity, if you hadn't your bones and what's left of your flesh would have made excellent fodder for my tinkering.
97985-progress.title: Thundering Hearts
